claims.finding: search_some proves zero prefix in the supplied list and a nonzero returned row; search_none characterizes list exhaustion. native_search_bound proves row eligibility and nonzero entry. Ascending/no-duplicate coverage of candidates versus Rust col..4 is not proved.

swapIndex is an involution including equal indices. swapRows permutes all five entries including RHS. Rowwise predicate equivalence supplies decoded equation-set equivalence for arbitrary decode; no primality or overflow assumptions needed for permutation alone.

selected_zero_prefix requires all eligible rows to have zero entries before col. It transfers that premise only; it does not establish the loop invariant. selected_pivot places the supplied nonzero entry on the diagonal.

Concrete matrix has eligible column values 0,2,3 at col1; selects row2 and moves RHS6 with coefficient2; prior row0 unchanged. Zero matrix exhausts search. All-ones and RHS-omission negatives reject unjustified prefix and coefficient-only swapping. These are prospective uncompiled controls.
